title: Aaj Duniya Me Aza Zainab e Dilgeer se Hai
body:
Aaj duniya me aza Zainab e dilgeer se hai
Deen o islam salamat gham e shabbir se hai
1. Khali gehwara jhulatey huwe bano ne kaha
Tujh se sikhwa nhi beta gila taqdeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zaqm akber ka joh dekha toh shah e dee'n ne
Kaha bugz ummat ko aye nana teri tasweer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Bandhker sehra usse ran ki izajat dedo
Arzoo bhai ki yeh hazrat e shabbir se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Zulm is tarha se beemar pe dhaye hai layee'n
Khoon Abid ka raha pa'oun ki zanjeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Apne seene pe Sakina ko sulana Zainab
Aqri arzoo yeh shah ki hamsheer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Karbala Shaam o Najaf ki ho ziyarat mujh ko
Bus ye zamin ki dua madar e shabbir se hai
Azz...zamin abedi
